_about: The presentation call. Peter Keller (EXT-04) rings during the franc spike. He is one of the ten clients read out of the side-challenge custody PDFs, so this call also shows the ex-custody import working end to end. Every line was checked against POST /ask first: all three questions return facts, and the second comes back as a chain. pause_before is the silence the advisor talks into.

lines.text: Hi, it's Peter Keller. The franc is all over the news this morning. How much has this cost me today?
Why is the dollar hitting me so hard?
And how big is my emerging markets position?
Right, that helps. Speak next week.
